description: With spread_mode strict, a file that must cover two failure domains waits for the other one, here full, rather than doubling up on its own; in prefer mode it falls back to its own domain.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
domain = "a"
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"
domain = "a"
[[disk]]
id = "t3"
uuid = "4f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t3"
fs = "ext4"
domain = "b"
[[rule]]
label = "strict"
path = "strict/**"
spread_mode = "strict"

steps.query: SELECT CAST(lpath AS TEXT), state FROM files ORDER BY lpath
